event: Nala swings her free leg over the beast and hooks her thighs around its neck.
Its head is still down at her calf, so her thighs close on the top of its neck, not the throat.
The nape quills punch through her tights into the insides of her thighs.
Fewer get through the cloth than went into her arms, but they go deep.

memory.fact: Its nape quills pierce tight cloth, but fewer get through than into bare skin.
Its nape quills pierce tight cloth, but fewer get through than into bare skin.

event: She squeezes with everything she has.
Under her legs there is only thick, hard muscle, and it does not give.
The beast does not choke, and its jaws stay locked on her calf.
Squeezed, it thrashes its whole body and wrenches its head hard against the bite.
The teeth tear deeper into her calf, and it hangs on and twists harder than before.

changes.note: The teeth tear deeper into her calf as it wrenches: 30

event: Her leg goes hot and then strangely weak, and her thighs loosen without her meaning them to.
Blood soaks dark through her tights down the length of her calf.
As it heaves, its throat turns up under her knee, bare and working, just below its locked jaw.

memory.fact: A shardback's throat is softer than its nape, but its jaw and bite sit right above it.
